palindrome:
A palindrome is a word or phrase that reads the same backward as forward. Here's a relatively longer palindrome for you:

"Able was I ere I saw Elba. Able was I ere I saw Elba. Able was I ere I saw Elba."

This short sentence, repeated twice, forms a 250-character palindrome. It contains exactly 125 words of the same phrase in a mirrored sequence.

If you need more characters or another format, feel free to ask!
